text:
maya: Noticed a reproducible bump in structured func-call parse failures on the new int8 build (horizon-liteq-v3-int8). ~3.9% parse errors vs 0.2% fp32.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy horizon-liteq-v3-int8 (canary=8%) started by @maya at 2026-03-22T02:05:00Z

oncall-bot: Alert: parse_failure_rate /invoke/horizon-liteq-v3-int8 = 3.9% (threshold 1%)

maya: example malformed payload (redacted):
```
{"fn":"assign_role","args":{"user":9001,"roles":["admin","editor"],},
}
```

alex: trailing comma before final brace and an extra newline token. looks like suffix emission noise. could be due to kv-cache boundary when streaming + quantized weights.

sam: are failures concentrated around nested arrays or code fences? that often trips tokenization/framing.

maya: yes, nested arrays and triple-backtick blocks show highest failure rates. ran a small seed-pair parity (200 prompts): int8 4.0% vs fp32 0.1%. token diffs show extra comma+\n token near array close.

katie: immediate low-risk mitigation idea: enable a canary-only postprocess pass that strips trailing commas and closes dangling brackets (soft repair). also record the original output to snapshot storage for offline review.

devex: can roll that as a canary feature-flag. also propose setting max_retries=1 with exponential backoff 50ms for parse failures so we get another shot without heavy latency hit.

alex: parallel experiments: 1) replicate with kv-cache disabled for int8 2) run quantization-aware tokenizer probe (check token splits/IDs) 3) run schema-heavy eval harness (500 prompts) comparing pass rates and token alignment score.

sam: i'll run kv-cache-off replicate on 1% traffic slice and post numbers. if parse failures drop substantially, that implicates cache boundary interaction.

maya: started job parity/599999/2k to capture token streams and stream offsets.

katie: also flagging product/support: if we enable soft-repair, we need a short support note explaining repairs may occur and how to identify repaired outputs so they can triage user reports.

deploy-bot: Patch queued by @devex -> horizon-liteq-v3-int8/canary (soft-repair + retry=1 + snapshotting)

maya: agreed on metrics abort: if downstream arg-mismatch errors exceed 0.3% or repair false-positive rate > 0.5% over 30m, abort canary.

oncall-bot: Acknowledged. Will re-alert if parse_failure_rate > 5% or downstream_error > 0.3%.

alex: i'll add a token-alignment column to the canary dashboard so we can correlate specific token offsets with parse failures.

sam: will post kv-off replicate results here in ~3h. if we see token-id shifts in the tokenizer probe, we may need to re-evaluate quantization mapping.

maya: TL;DR: int8 canary shows suffix-token noise causing trailing commas; mitigation = canary-only soft-repair + 1 retry + snapshotting; follow-ups = kv-cache toggle, tokenizer probe, schema eval.

katie: thanks team. i'll draft the support blurb and add a note to the canary dashboard. :memo:

maya: closing for now, will update when parity results land.
